svg.text: weight-stationary systolic array, ROWS=4 COLS=2 S_MAX=6, signed INT8 in, INT8 out
byte shift chain, no address decoder
weight byte chain, 8 bytes in reverse raster order
one MAC per cycle, no compute enable
one PE per cycle, so PE(r,c) sees the sample from cycle r+c
one row per cycle, complete at the bottom of column c
8 bytes shifted in once, reused by every sample
result path, one output element at a time
acc x M, one shared adder
2 column sums, one per cycle, staggered by one cycle per column
readback mux: results, raw accumulators, status, identity block
